profile.headline: Experienced Software Developer
profile.summary: I am currently a software developer at London Computer Systems, specializing in C# .NET development and working in a Typescript solution with a C# API backend.  I have five years experience in C# and SQL.  Information technology is not just a career for me, but a passion. Learning new technologies is what drives me most, and I am always looking for opportunities to further my education.
